objective: Assess only the retained bounded startup presentation of an explicitly selected project.

criteria.description: The retained startup frames show a nonblank, visually coherent project presentation without a dominant rendering failure.
passAnchors: the stage is nonblank and its primary visible content is coherent
no full-stage corruption or missing-renderer failure dominates the frames
failAnchors: the stage is blank or uniformly empty
the presentation is dominated by severe clipping, corruption, or missing content
